evidence_items.locator: opening paragraph; section 2 (Details of the Transaction) and section 4 (Timeline) give a USD 10.0 billion first closing planned for mid-April 2025

evidence_items.explanation: The lead investor disclosed a signed agreement dated March 31, 2025 (U.S. time) to invest up to USD 40.0 billion, with a USD 10.0 billion first closing planned for mid-April 2025. Even the first closing alone exceeds the $6.5 billion to $7 billion threshold.
